Integrated with CallDirector, LoadoutManager, MissionDirector. GUT tests (22 tests).

P4-08.note: EndingResolver autoload: evaluates final ending based on Public Trust, Station Budget, Cult Awareness, flags (lake_house_cleared, cult_leaders_arrested), and shift performance. Three endings: SIEGE (Trust<20 or Cult≥90), SHADOW_WAR (Trust 20-40, Cult 60-89), RECLAMATION (Trust≥40, Cult<60, lake_house_cleared). Ending scene with title, description, stats breakdown, and unlocked content. GUT tests (10 tests).

P4-10.note: Shifts 2 & 3 content authored: Interrogation call (call_interrogation) with arrested Ambush Leader Viktor Kolesov revealing Miller's Quarry cult hideout; Cult hideout mission call (call_cult_hideout) at Miller's Quarry with Dead Frequency relay, anomaly presence (EMF 5.0), 12-15 hostiles; 4 Diversion calls (break-in, suspicious van, domestic disturbance, warehouse noise complaint) with DIVERSION truth type pulling team from real threats. All calls include DialogueGraph with class-exclusive choices, StressProfiles with authored tremor/pitch curves, RecordEntries, and flag-gated triggers (ambush_leader_arrested, mission_unlocked_cult_hideout).

P4-13.note: Audio polish: 13-bus layout (Master, Music, Ambience, Foley, SFX, Phone, VoiceProximity, VoiceRadio, Record, Panic, UI, RadioChatter, VHS) with FX chains. 12 ambience tracks (station/field/horror/siege/aftermath) with layered beds + oneshots. 76 foley definitions (footsteps 7 surfaces×3 movement types, doors, equipment, weapons, interactions, environment) with class modifiers. 19 music stingers (tension low/med/high, scare subtle/major/anomaly, resolution minor/major/failure, 4 ambient drones, 3 transitions, 3 endings). AudioServer autoload for playback. MIX_PASS.md documents bus routing, loudness targets (-14 LUFS Master), sanity-driven Panic bus, Tension Director music, distance attenuation, class modifiers, integration hooks, and validation checklist.

P5-03.note: Crash reporting & telemetry opt-in: TelemetrySettings resource (consent, opt-in/opt-out, GDPR deletion), TelemetryManager autoload (anonymous KPIs: session length, shift progression, call outcomes, mission results, endings, traits, performance metrics, hardware info), CrashReporter autoload (script exception capture, crash dump writing, Steam crash reporting placeholder). GameSettings integration with privacy tab (consent dialog with three options: full telemetry, crash reports only, decline), settings persistence, GDPR data deletion request. GUT tests written (35 tests covering settings, manager, reporter, GameSettings integration, and full consent flow).
